items.title: Constructible subsets of an inverse limit of spectral spaces are pullbacks of constructible subsets
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file topology.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The counted statement shows that every constructible subset of an inverse limit of spectral spaces is the preimage of a constructible subset of one of the stages (author lemma at source lines 5078-5087, label lemma-inverse-limit-spectral-spaces-constructible). The proof (source lines 5089-5116) writes the subset as a finite Boolean combination of pullbacks of open sets and uses the directedness of the index set to place all of them at a single stage (proof lines 5089-5115). The finiteness-and-directedness step is the content. H3.
